title: TrackDefinition
description: One track. The closed spline drives road mesh, checkpoints, AI line, positions, wrong-way, respawn and minimap.

medalTimesMs.description: Time Trial thresholds at 150cc. Gold on every track in a cup drives unlocks (design §10).

voidY.description: World Y below which a kart respawns at its last checkpoint

controlPoints.description: Closed Catmull-Rom control points in world metres. halfWidth and surface apply from this point to the next.

bank.description: Roll in degrees, positive banks into a right turn

t.description: Spline fraction of the start line

tunnel.description: The stretch (fractions of the shortcut's length) that runs through a mine: rock walls at the curb, a timber-framed rock roof with lanterns, and the land rising over it as a mesa (the hill tunnelHill metres above the road, reached tunnelRamp metres in from each portal). Karts are held inside; the off-road beside the approach narrows to the mouth over tunnelFunnel metres.

speed.description: m/s for rolling/crossing/falling; gust push strength

offset.description: type vent: seconds into its cycle at race time 0, so vents side by side take turns

launch.description: type vent: m/s up it throws a kart (default builder ventLaunch)

creature.description: type creature: the track's big creature (design §6); lateral's sign picks its side of the road

offroad.description: The Mario Kart World edge: the land meets the curb with no strip and no wall; it is drivable (the dirt top-speed cap) out to an invisible course limit offroadReach metres past the curb, where the roadside scenery starts. False (a pier, a sky road): a solid low edge wall at the road's edge.

loops.description: Loop-the-loops on the main line (design.md Track thrills). Every kart on the ground is caught before the foot at t, rides up and round the ring and is set down after it with a boost. Put one on a straight at least approach + exit metres long.

t.description: main-line t of the ring's foot

openEdges.description: Stretches of the main line with no wall on one or both sides (left = negative lateral). Past the shoulder there is no ground: a kart falls and the claw brings it back.

jumps.description: Trick ramps. Leaving a jump airborne with the hop button pressed awards a trick boost.

shape.description: ramp: a striped wedge across the road up to a lip at t; hump: a trick bump (dune, mogul) whose crest is at t (design.md Track thrills)

run.description: metres along the road the ramp rises over, or the bump spans (default builder rampRun / humpRun)

rise.description: metres the lip or crest stands above the road (default builder rampRise / humpRise)

shortcut.description: Shortcut id this jump sits on; t stays main-equivalent

double.description: A gold double balloon: fills both item slots at once (design §8)

finalLapShift.description: Exactly one readable change on the last lap. Fires once, globally, when the race leader starts the final lap.

label.description: Banner text, e.g. 'THE TIDE IS IN'

routeOverrides.description: Replace a t-range of the main spline (bridges retract, rail becomes mandatory). The LUT is rebuilt once when the shift fires.

gripMultiplier.description: Global grip scale, e.g. 0.8 for wet grass

ground.description: One flat plane under the whole track. 'none' for sky tracks; the void is below voidY.

band.description: verge: an off-road track's small ground cover (flowers, tufts, stones) on the drivable land between the curb and the course limit; visual only, karts drive through it

footing.description: Out at sea: each one stands on its own wooden pier, raised pierLift above the water

lift.description: Metres above its band's ground: a model centred on its middle (a hazard's) sits on the ground with lift = its radius

layout.description: scatter: little groups with open ground between; row: runs of pieces `every` metres apart along the road, turned along it, local +X away from the road (fences, lamp posts, corner signs, a ski lift, cliff walls); span: one piece across the road, its legs past the course limit (bunting, a rock arch)

every.description: row: metres between pieces along the road

at.description: [t0, t1]: group centres stay in this stretch of the main line (t0 > t1 wraps past the start)

side.description: Which side of the road; default: the outside of corners, favoured

dist.description: Overrides the band's [near, far] metres (past the curb for roadside and verge, from the centreline for far)

scale.description: Random uniform scale range (default [0.7, 1.3]; rows and spans 1)

merge.description: A code-built (vertex-coloured) model baked into the track's merged dressing chunks, one draw per chunk for every merged kind, instead of an instancer of its own

landmarkFooting.description: The landmark stands on a wooden pier (a sea track)

landmark.description: The thing visible from the start line

mirrored.description: Never authored: set by track-builder mirror.ts on a track reflected left to right for Mirror mode (design §10). Every lateral, bank and side in it is already flipped.

builder.description: Track-builder constants. Never set per track; the defaults are the only values. Code reads them from here (docs/sops/track-builder.md Constants).

arcDivisions.description: Fine steps used to walk the curve before resampling

branchHysteresis.description: metres; another branch must be closer by this much to win

branchLeaveMargin.description: metres inside a road edge a kart still counts as on that road; another branch can only take it once it is past this. Must exceed kartRadius (0.85): the wall holds a kart exactly one radius inside the edge, so at 0.85 nobody could ever leave

minTurnRadiusFactor.description: turn radius must be >= factor × halfWidth (hairpin guard)

branchBlendMetres.description: a shortcut ribbon loses its kerbs and sinks 3 cm for this long at each end, where it overlaps the main road

rampSkirt.description: Off-road tracks: metres past the curb over which a ramp's sides slope down to the sand (karts beside a ramp drive up its side instead of popping up a square edge)

tunnelWall.description: metres: a tunnel's side walls rise this high above the road before the roof arches over

tunnelApex.description: metres: the top of a tunnel's arched roof above the road

tunnelHill.description: metres: the land over a tunnel stands this high above its road (a mesa the mine runs through)

tunnelRamp.description: metres in from a portal over which the land rises to tunnelHill: the mesa ends in a cliff, and the portal is a rock face in it (mesh/tunnel.ts)

tunnelMesaTop.description: metres of the mesa's flat top past where a road's shoulder would end, before its sides fall away (a ridge over the mine, not a plateau)

tunnelFunnel.description: metres before a portal over which the off-road beside the approach narrows to the curb, guiding karts into the mouth

tunnelFrameSpacing.description: metres between the timber frames inside a tunnel

tunnelLanternSpacing.description: metres between lanterns inside a tunnel (alternate walls)

offroadReach.description: Off-road tracks: metres past the curb the ground is drivable (slowly) before an invisible course limit, just short of the roadside scenery (the Mario Kart World way: no strip, no wall along the road)

offroadDrop.description: Off-road tracks: the ground past the curb sits this far under the road, as the land mesh draws it

roadTileLength.description: metres of road per UV v unit

rampRun.description: metres a ramp rises over to its lip (karts drive up it: kart-controller jumpLift)

rampRise.description: height of a ramp's lip above the road, metres

humpRun.description: metres along the road a trick bump spans

humpRise.description: height of a trick bump's crest, metres

loopShift.description: metres the ring moves right in one turn: the way in (left of centre) never meets the way out (right)

loopSpread.description: metres either side of its lane a kart rides round, by where it came in (karts side by side stay side by side)

loopApproach.description: metres before the foot a kart is caught and eased into the entry lane

loopExit.description: metres after the foot a kart is set down in the exit lane

loopWidth.description: width of the ring's track, metres

humpEdge.description: metres over which a trick bump rounds off to the road at each kerb

pierLift.description: A pier's deck stands this far above the sea (level with a sea track's coast)

ventRadius.description: a launch vent's mouth, metres (design.md Track thrills)

ventWarnSeconds.description: a vent glows and bubbles this long before it erupts

ventEruptSeconds.description: how long a vent erupts; a kart on it then is thrown up

ventLaunch.description: m/s up a vent throws a kart, about 4 m high (a ramp is 5 to 6)

fallingWarnSeconds.description: a falling hazard drops this long before it lands (and can hit), its shadow growing on the spot

fallingHeight.description: metres above the road a falling hazard drops from

gustWindow.description: metres along the road a gust acts over

roadsideOffroad.description: the roadside band on an off-road track: just past the course limit, so the scenery lines the course

verge.description: metres past the curb for an off-road track's ground cover: past a ramp's skirt (rampSkirt), inside the course limit (offroadReach)

lapTimeWarn.description: seconds; estimated lap outside this warns
